title: Round Coordinates
scope: Round node coordinates half up in glyph coordinates and optionally component offsets; fractional shape offsets kept. In-place setters are meant to keep node names and flags, as source-traced but not measured. Anchors unchanged. Shared App geometry history and read-back; the change is recorded as one Undo step. Native acceptance pending.

title: Remove Overlap
scope: Native contour intersections or same-direction nesting required before FontGate merge; one result per shape id per scan. Separate shapes and single self-intersecting contours kept. FontGate assign replaces appearance and loses node names, flags, contour names and corner_smooth. Restore surviving start points. Snapshot existing final Smooth-control conditions; report newly introduced conditions as save-risk advice, outside failed-store mismatches. Shared App geometry history and read-back; the change is recorded as one Undo step. Native acceptance pending.

title: Add Extremes
scope: Cubic derivative roots and native insertNodeTo; cuts within 0.1002 Manhattan units of endpoints or accepted cuts kept. New nodes follow native rounding; closed PostScript contours only. Structural master compatibility hold. Shared App geometry history and read-back; the change is recorded as one Undo step. Native acceptance pending.

title: Correct Contour Direction
scope: Native clockwise and contains with all segment start and midpoint tests. Same-shape nesting decides edits, matching flShapeData::setDirection. When layer-wide nesting differs in parity, keep the contour and list inside another shape, direction left. Native segments handle quadratic implied points; overlapping outers remain outer. Snapshot existing final Smooth-control conditions and report only newly introduced conditions as save-risk advice. Shared App geometry history and read-back; the change is recorded as one Undo step. Native acceptance pending.

title: Straighten Short Curves
scope: Chord and handle tolerance with native convertToLine; FontLab recomputes smooth flags at both ends. Structural master compatibility hold. Shared App geometry history and read-back; the change is recorded as one Undo step. Native acceptance pending.

title: Optimize Start Points
scope: Bottom-left on-curve or match-current-master start with native setStartPoint. In-place rotation is meant to keep node flags; Safety describes the VFJ reopen risk. All moves planned before writing; structural master compatibility hold. Snapshot existing final Smooth-control conditions and report only newly introduced conditions as save-risk advice. Shared App geometry history and read-back; the change is recorded as one Undo step. Native acceptance pending.

title: Delete Small Contours
scope: Strict unsigned analytic area through fly.ap.contour_selection; closed contours only. Open contours listed as open contour, kept without area measurement. Requires App fontui extra. Native removeContour and master compatibility hold. Shared App geometry history and read-back; the change is recorded as one Undo step. Native acceptance pending.

title: Fix Zero Handles
scope: Double-zero curves to native convertToLine; both end smooth flags recomputed. Optional single-handle pull rounded to whole units; Smooth-base handles can become non-collinear and later realign. Shared App geometry history and read-back; the change is recorded as one Undo step. Native acceptance pending.

title: Delete Duplicate Contours
scope: Same-direction closed cyclic duplicates only. Every member with a reversed counterpart is listed as reversed duplicate, kept, including further copies; open contours kept. Native removeContour and master compatibility hold. Shared App geometry history and read-back; the change is recorded as one Undo step. Native acceptance pending.

title: Transform
scope: App affine scale/skew/rotation/move about a per-layer origin. Bake plain unshared translation-only outlines; compose transforms for components and shared/scaled shapes. Optional anchors with App near-origin Redo refusal; painted preview. Shared App geometry history and read-back; the change is recorded as one Undo step. Native acceptance pending.

title: Slant
scope: App affine slant with baseline or half-x-height pivot per master. Button explicitly copies current master italic angle to the common angle field. Bake plain unshared outlines; compose transforms for components and shared/scaled shapes. Optional anchors with App near-origin Redo refusal; painted preview. Shared App geometry history and read-back; the change is recorded as one Undo step. Native acceptance pending.

title: Placeholder Glyphs
scope: Empty glyphs through App glyph_creation and fontpr set_glyph(create=True), with master widths and optional Unicode, Font-window guards, auto-rebuild consent and read-back. Each new glyph is recorded as its own Undo step. Non-ASCII characters map to Unicode names; ASCII tokens are glyph names. Offline verification only; native acceptance pending.

title: Shadow Copy
scope: One shifted shadow element; node names and raw flags repaired, selection cleared. Other node properties and contour names are not repaired; copied contours merge, source element names and notes are not copied. Each Apply is recorded as one Undo step. Offline verification only; native acceptance pending.

App glyph_copies/glyph_creation, auto-rebuild consent and read-back. Each new glyph is recorded as its own Undo step, and the outlines as one more Undo step. Offline verification only; native acceptance pending.

App glyph_copies/glyph_creation, auto-rebuild consent and read-back. Each new glyph is recorded as its own Undo step, and the outlines as one more Undo step. Offline verification only; native acceptance pending.

Offline verification only; native acceptance pending.

Source-only master/options/stored-data/node-link caveat documented. Each Apply is recorded as one Undo step. Offline verification only; native acceptance pending.

title: Real English Text
original_scope_acceptance: pending: native new-tab content, source binding and complete preservation
scope: Open one new native Glyph tab for the captured current font. Sample five distinct passages without replacement, preserving case, punctuation and a final space. Use 24 original English passages instead of the upstream 300 third-party excerpts. Unlike the upstream sampling, no passage repeats within one proof. Pass missing characters unchanged. Refuse unsafe text before creation. No font-data write.

title: Real Spanish Text
original_scope_acceptance: pending: native new-tab content, source binding and complete preservation
scope: Open one new native Glyph tab for the captured current font. Sample five distinct passages without replacement, preserving case, accents, punctuation and a final space. Use 24 original Spanish passages instead of the upstream 300 third-party excerpts. Unlike the upstream sampling, no passage repeats within one proof. Pass missing characters unchanged. Refuse unsafe text before creation. No font-data write.

title: Smart Slant
scope: Selected glyphs and chosen masters; compensate measured ink bounds after shear. Keep both sidebearings by adjusting advance, or preserve advance and original ink centre. Adds spacing compensation beyond native Slant, Slant by Italic Angle, Actions Oblique and Scripts/Contours/Slant.py. Optional anchor transforms; shared transform writer and complete baked-node read-back. Unsupported layer content becomes a note while other glyphs remain editable.

title: Node Duplicator
scope: Combine all-master duplication with Paths/Node Duplicator (current layer).py, SHA256 f6b7bc79856f85611abc485a8df959486afdb76c50e400b5e82f19f2b794c2c7, and Paths/Node Duplicator + 2 Handles (all masters).py, SHA256 eccf4cef027becf7fca14f29de6fde68bea8e0aaeca513c08ba75b717556cddc. One deadline-bound selection snapshot per plan supplies scope and per-glyph reference indices. Full contour correspondence, optional coincident cubic controls, and explicit auxiliary-layer mode. Unsupported content becomes notes; mismatched master edits are held when compatibility checking is enabled.

title: Decompose Named Components
source_attribution: Copyright 2025 Fernando Díaz & Reset Type Studio
scope: Selected glyphs; current or all masters, initially all. Exact source-name filter and recursive decomposition inside matched occurrences. Preview reads source-layer counts without updating builders or making native copies. Apply prepares detached copies and compares contour counts before history. Unrelated siblings remain linked. Refused occurrences are kept rows. One geometry history commit with retained removed components and read-back.

title: Set Component Locations
source_attribution: Copyright 2025 Fernando Díaz & Reset Type Studio
scope: Batch component locations with one coordinate row per component/master occurrence. Rows start at current component coordinates; Set writes only edited rows and retains an existing @node suffix. Reset sets Base layer name to the host master layer and skips existing matches. Defaults to all components in selected glyphs; optional Glyph-window component selection matches position and source name across masters. Optional exact-name filter. Validate declared axes, finite values and design bounds. Shared data and refused items are kept rows. Preview precedes one geometry history commit with read-back; no-change actions create no history.

title: Trial Font Maker
scope: Current FontLab selection supplies exported glyph names. Non-modal preview processes matching static OTF/TTF exports. Layout closure is off by default; optional ligature expansion lists additional glyphs in Preview. Kerning and positioning remain unless explicitly removed. Prefix localized identity records and CFF names; preserve copyright, licence records and source binaries. Require separate input/output folders and never overwrite. Cache source inspection across prefix and checkbox edits; rescan on folder or selection change or Refresh Exports. Refuse changed source bytes before writing. Requires user-installed public fontTools. No live-font write.

title: Magic Remover
source_license: not declared in inspected source tree
scope: One selected Glyph window slot; preview corresponding polygon nodes, whole contours and components across compatible foreground master and intermediate layers. If any compatible master must keep an item, every master keeps it, with one named reason. Empty outline shapes are removed. Anchors remain unchanged because pin selection is not bound. Partial curve-node selections are kept; use native Delete with synchronized Remove node. Component removal retains original history objects. Mask backup remains a separate workflow.
release_gate: pending owned native panel, complete font preservation, Undo, Redo and save-reopen verification

title: Set Intermediate Layer
source_license: not declared in inspected source tree
scope: Selected glyphs in fonts with declared axes; explicit design coordinates on every axis; native interpolation into location-named intermediate layers. Declared axis-key case is preserved for interpolation; layer names use lower-case keys. Existing locations, incompatible masters and unsafe glyphs receive kept rows. Layer addition is confirmed by name read-back after the void native addLayer call. Fractional coordinates and existing editor slots are preserved. The addition is recorded as one Undo step.
release_gate: pending owned native interpolation, panel, complete font preservation, Undo, Redo and save-reopen verification

title: Paste Glyph Order Encoding
scope: Modeless insertion of pasted current-font glyph names before the initially selected glyph. Unknown names are reported and repetitions removed. Unsupported names, including non-ASCII names, receive named kept rows and are omitted while supported rows save. Each capture receives a fresh deadline. Saving checks the live font order through a names-only capture, so clearing selection after preview does not prevent saving. Header ID is -1 and its name is the file stem. Existing files and stored glyph indices remain unchanged. Import through File > Import > Encoding; use the encoding chooser's Refresh button as needed.

title: Master Twins
scope: Non-modal current-font master copier with selection or whole-font scope and independent contours, components, anchors and metrics switches. Refused glyphs appear as kept rows while eligible glyphs copy. Hints keep a glyph only when contours are copied; transferTTH is not used. Shared shape data, named contours and nodes with an explicit corner_smooth value are kept. Other node and contour properties are not detected and not copied. contour_copy restores node names and raw flags, clearing selection; element names, notes and transforms are copied explicitly. Removed components retain history objects. Catalogue and auto facts are cached per Refresh and refreshed before Copy. Check master compatibility after copying contours or components.

title: Deliver Glyphs
scope: Non-modal source-retaining delivery to each user-activated destination Font window. Stored font identities and workspace/fontpr lookups use fgId; the active-window guard receives the package object id. Master names match without case or surrounding spaces; unmatched masters use the captured source master and are listed. Refused glyphs appear as kept rows while others copy. New glyphs use glyph_creation, including checked creation results, explicit glyph_name, Unicode values, suffix-scoped automatic rebuild consent and automatic-layer read-back. Existing Unicode lists remain unchanged; conflicting code points keep the glyph. The result declares new glyphs receiving Unicode assignments. Transfers outlines, anchors, advances and metrics expressions. Components, hints, shared shape data, named contours and nodes with an explicit corner_smooth value are kept. Other node and contour properties are not detected and not copied. Units per em must match. Category, subcategory, script and export status are not transferred. contour_copy restores node names and raw flags, clearing selection; element names, notes and transforms are copied explicitly.

title: Style Linker
scope: Non-modal exportable-instance preview with whole-word Bold, Italic and Oblique matching across width groups. Lists missing typographic style names and other kept rows. Copies only explicit base Style Groups; automatic base groups are kept because per-instance tfn is not exposed by the Python API. Native autoSLV/autoSGN and multi-instance controls remain available in Font Info. Checks the bound fgId and preview values before assignment. Uses the Font Info notification list [package, package.mastersContainer()] before assignment and again afterwards, followed by UpdateAll. Native instance values retain family names and hidden properties; setter failures restore original values and report the Undo hint.

title: Master Text Comparison
license_note: Root LICENSE is MIT; upstream README declares Apache-2.0. Preserve both notices.
scope: Over FontLab's Glyph-window multi-master text views and Text By Master, this adds comma-separated word groups and file presets with exact per-slot layers. Non-modal panel uses proof.font_maps with first-encoded-name-wins lookup. Preflight checks all requested layers. One call to the public named_tab.open_layer_rows opens one tab: side by side puts each word group on one row with a space between master copies; stacked puts each word/master on one row, with blank group separators. Preset paths remain in the panel until Close; UTF-8 BOM and newline normalization are reported.

title: Common Glyphs
license_note: Root LICENSE is MIT; upstream README declares Apache-2.0. Preserve both notices.
scope: Over FontLab's Glyph-window multi-master text views and Text By Master, this adds an exact-name proof set shared by every open font, with per-font encodings. Map AllFonts fonts to registered packages through FontGate IDs and read canonical font.glyphs lists twice. Publish sorted shared names, slash proof text, current-font encoded characters and complete per-font Unicode assignments in the shared report panel. Refuse changed registrations, invalid records and expired scans. Use stored FontLab names in place of Glyphs production-name conversion. The optional source label-colour action is omitted.

title: Add Anchors From File
scope: Import a complete UTF-8 CSV anchor table into named glyphs on the current master. Strip header whitespace and reject unknown columns, malformed rows and missing glyphs. Round coordinates half up before preview and writing. Report only actual BOM and newline conversions. Non-modal Browse, Load and Import panel. Each application is recorded as one Undo step.

title: Auto Cursive Attachment Add Anchors
scope: Read a reusable cursive sample and preview missing entry/exit anchors on selected current-master glyphs. Use the right-to-left convention: exit at the left edge, entry at the right edge. Score thickness and polygon-edge tangents, preserve existing pins and accept perfect zero scores. Require closed decomposed outlines and matching master names. Layer failures become note rows. Report actual text conversions. Each application is recorded as one Undo step.

title: Auto Cursive Attachment Get Sample
scope: Measure entry/exit anchors inside one selected body layer and save a new JSON file containing master name, mean ink distances and polygon-edge tangent estimates. The owned save chooser starts in the home folder and avoids overwrite confirmation for files that will be kept. Existing-file attempts request a new name. The font is read only.

title: Copy Myanmar Anchors
scope: Capture Myanmar Unicode routing once per scan. Copy U+101D and U+1000 anchors to their respective bowl families across named masters. Cache each source layer once per plan and bound source and target work per layer. Doubtful layers become note rows while clean masters continue. Adds a Unicode routing preset to the two manual passes available in Copy Anchors From Glyph. Each application is recorded as one Undo step.

title: Derive Anchors From Components
scope: Capture glyph names once per scan and inspect manual composites across named masters with a separate budget per layer. Infer each missing base label from its first mark in component order, including stacked accents. Honour mark transforms, inverse base transforms and explicit mark-layer references. Ambiguous marks, missing or automatic references, non-master bases and layer failures become note rows. Cross-composite conflicts remove only the affected base label. Clean labels and layers continue. Each application is recorded as one Undo step.

title: Optical Center
scope: Flatten the shared placed layer path once, including components. At at most 512 columns, compute exact filled-span lengths from the flattened rings with nonzero winding. Counters require correctly directed contours. Blend one third toward the horizontal ink median from the bounds centre. Give each layer its own time budget; refused layers become note rows while other selected layers continue. Report the estimate and optionally align an existing top anchor. Each application is recorded as one Undo step.

title: Remove Extraneous Mark Anchors
scope: Preview conditional anchor removal across all masters of selected glyphs: remove bottom where _top exists and top where _bottom exists. Keep other pins and automatic layers. Refuse unsafe dependencies before writing. Each application is recorded as one Undo step.
